info.title: LargitData Social Media API: Weibo, Xiaohongshu (RedNote), Douyin, Threads
info.description: Endpoint reference for the commercial LargitData Social Media API on Weibo, Xiaohongshu (RedNote), Douyin and Threads, written from the 2026-10-25 specification snapshot. Data is collected by web crawlers from content publicly published on each platform. Collection endpoints are asynchronous: create a task, poll it by ID, read the results once DONE. API keys are issued after a trial request: https://www.largitdata.com/en/social-media-api/#api-inquiry. Full documentation: https://api.infominer.io/docs

post.summary: Creates a comment task from a video URL; 50 comments by default, adjustable with max_items or get_all.

crawl_second_layer.description: Only false is supported; second-layer replies are not available.

get_all.description: Remove the default 50-comment cap. An explicit max_items takes precedence.

max_items.description: Maximum comments to collect; 0 or negative means no item cap.

order_type.description: Only hot is accepted: stored comments are ranked by like count when you read them. It does not change what is collected.

get.summary: Returns the stored comments of the video, up to 1000 per page, sorted hot or by time.

parameters.description: Task ID returned when the task was created.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number, starting at 1.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Comments per page, max 1000.

parameters.name: order_type
parameters.description: Optional read-time sort: hot (like count, highest first) or time (newest first). Omit to keep the order saved at creation.

get.description: Response fields: id, post_id, author, author_id, content, push_type, sentiment, tm, tm_crawler, region.
